"""Load both labeled CSV roots into the local DuckDB output port."""

from __future__ import annotations

import importlib.util
import os
import sys
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any


def _configure_nxd_imports() -> None:
    """Prefer installed wheels; use a compiled source checkout only as fallback."""
    try:
        installed = all(
            importlib.util.find_spec(module) is not None
            for module in ("nxd.core", "nxd.drivers", "nxd.data_product")
        )
    except (ImportError, ValueError):
        installed = False
    if installed:
        return
    repo_root = os.environ.get("NXD_DESKTOP_REPO_ROOT")
    if not repo_root:
        return
    root = Path(repo_root)
    sources = (
        root / "components/nxd_py/data_product",
        root / "components/nxd_py/core",
        root / "components/nxd_py/drivers",
    )
    compiled = (
        root / "components/nxd_py/core/nxd/core",
        root / "components/nxd_py/drivers/nxd/drivers",
    )
    if not all(any(directory.glob("_bindings*.so")) for directory in compiled):
        return
    for source in reversed(sources):
        sys.path.insert(0, str(source))


_configure_nxd_imports()

import dlt
from dlt.sources.filesystem import filesystem, read_csv

from nxd import data_product
from nxd.core.context import DuckDbOutput


BASE_MODELS = ("orders", "users")
PHYSICAL_MODELS = BASE_MODELS


def _pinned_source_root(label: str) -> Path:
    """Resolve a labeled root from the immutable execution root only."""
    execution_root = Path(os.environ["NXD_TRANSFORM_ROOT"])
    path_file = execution_root / f"csv-source-{label}-path"
    relative_root = Path(path_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8").strip())
    expected_root = Path(f"data-{label}")
    if relative_root != expected_root:
        raise RuntimeError(
            f"path file for {label} must name {expected_root!s}, got {relative_root!s}"
        )
    if not relative_root.parts or relative_root.is_absolute() or ".." in relative_root.parts:
        raise RuntimeError(f"invalid relative path for {label}: {relative_root!s}")
    root = execution_root / expected_root
    if not root.is_dir():
        raise RuntimeError(f"labeled source root is missing for {label}: {root!s}")
    return root


@data_product.on_transform()
def ingest(duckdb: DuckDbOutput, secrets: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
    """Read both pinned labeled roots and land their promised tables."""
    del secrets  # Labeled CSV roots are carried by the pinned companion tree.
    run_dir = Path(duckdb.path).parent
    pipelines_dir = run_dir / "dlt-pipelines"
    pipelines_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    os.environ["DLT_DATA_DIR"] = str(run_dir / "dlt-data")

    pipeline = dlt.pipeline(
        pipelines_dir=str(pipelines_dir),
        destination=dlt.destinations.duckdb(credentials=duckdb.path),
        dataset_name=duckdb.schema,
    )
    resources = []
    for label, model in (("orders", "orders"), ("users", "users")):
        source_root = _pinned_source_root(label)
        reader = filesystem(
            bucket_url=str(source_root / model), file_glob="*.csv"
        ) | read_csv()
        resources.append(reader.with_name(duckdb.model_tables[model]))

    pipeline.run(resources, write_disposition="replace")

    actual = set(pipeline.default_schema.data_table_names())
    expected = {duckdb.model_tables[model] for model in PHYSICAL_MODELS}
    if actual != expected:
        raise RuntimeError(
            f"dlt produced tables {sorted(actual)!r}, expected {sorted(expected)!r}"
        )
    (run_dir / ".transform-complete").touch()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    data_product.main()

"""Load the two labeled CSV roots into the local DuckDB output port."""

from __future__ import annotations

import os
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

import dlt
from dlt.sources.filesystem import filesystem, read_csv

from nxd import data_product
from nxd.core.context import DuckDbOutput


BASE_MODELS = ("orders", "users")
DERIVED_MODELS = ()
PHYSICAL_MODELS = BASE_MODELS + DERIVED_MODELS


def _labeled_root(transform_root: Path, path_file: str) -> Path:
    """Resolve a connector path file strictly below the pinned root."""
    relative = (transform_root / path_file).read_text(encoding="utf-8").strip()
    candidate = Path(relative)
    if not relative or candidate.is_absolute() or ".." in candidate.parts:
        raise RuntimeError(f"connector path must be relative and contained: {relative!r}")
    return transform_root / candidate


@data_product.on_transform()
def ingest(duckdb: DuckDbOutput, secrets: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
    """Read both labeled roots from the immutable supervisor execution root."""
    del secrets  # Labeled CSV roots are carried by path files, not secret keys.
    transform_root = Path(os.environ["NXD_TRANSFORM_ROOT"])
    orders_root = _labeled_root(transform_root, "csv-source-orders-path")
    users_root = _labeled_root(transform_root, "csv-source-users-path")

    run_dir = Path(duckdb.path).parent
    pipelines_dir = run_dir / "dlt-pipelines"
    pipelines_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    os.environ["DLT_DATA_DIR"] = str(run_dir / "dlt-data")

    pipeline = dlt.pipeline(
        pipelines_dir=str(pipelines_dir),
        destination=dlt.destinations.duckdb(credentials=duckdb.path),
        dataset_name=duckdb.schema,
    )
    resources = [
        (
            filesystem(bucket_url=str(orders_root / "orders"), file_glob="*.csv")
            | read_csv()
        ).with_name(duckdb.model_tables["orders"]),
        (
            filesystem(bucket_url=str(users_root / "users"), file_glob="*.csv")
            | read_csv()
        ).with_name(duckdb.model_tables["users"]),
    ]
    pipeline.run(resources, write_disposition="replace")

    actual = set(pipeline.default_schema.data_table_names())
    expected = {duckdb.model_tables[model] for model in PHYSICAL_MODELS}
    if actual != expected:
        raise RuntimeError(
            f"dlt produced tables {sorted(actual)!r}, expected {sorted(expected)!r}"
        )
    (run_dir / ".transform-complete").touch()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    data_product.main()
